data.title: 火打谷爱衣 · 周末居室的露肩毛衣独处
data.description: 暖黄色壁灯亮起的私密卧室内，爱衣坐在木质地板坐垫上。宽松的米白色落肩毛衣微微滑落，露出精致锁骨与雪白香肩。她双手抱着曲起的双膝，目光闪烁地望向镜头，眼中带着不加掩饰的依恋与少女独有的心跳张力。
data.location: cozy wooden bedroom corner with warm fairy lights
data.action: sitting on floor cushion hugging knees, oversized off-shoulder knit sweater slipping down, bare collarbone, shy blushing expression, warm dim lighting
data.lighting: warm amber bedside lamp creating intimate golden glow
data.mood: vulnerable sweet domesticity, unspoken youthful romance
data.promptProse: Sitting on a floor cushion hugging her knees in her room, Mei wears an oversized off-shoulder knit sweater. Soft room lighting accentuates her bare collarbones and flushed cheeks as she gazes forward with pure, tender emotion.
data.animaCaption: Mei hugging her knees in an off-shoulder knit sweater in her bedroom, blushing warmly.
